entities.name: Neo-Assyrian Empire
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Neo-Assyrian Empire, a political institution in Iraq during Babylonian and Assyrian Empires (911 BCE–609 BCE). Grew from Amorite and Old Babylonian Kingdom and Hammurabi. Led to the emergence of Persian and Fall of Nineveh to the Medes and Babylonians.
